spec_features.spec_quote: early_stop_on_abandon: stop once the agent calls give_up or emits explicit give-up language. Continuing past abandonment burns tokens for no signal.
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:111 declared_giveup = heuristics.declares_giveup(...) or (parsed[0]=='give_up'); loop.py:167-169 `if cfg.early_stop_on_abandon and (sandbox.gave_up or declared_giveup): stop_reason='abandoned'; break`. give_up tool is dispatched (base.py:94-96 sets gave_up=True) and the loop breaks. Wired from config at runner.py:97.
spec_features.notes: Both the give_up tool call (via sandbox.gave_up) and lexical give-up detection trigger the break. End-to-end enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Early-stop conditions keep token spend low: an explicit give_up, or a tight identical-action loop

spec_features.spec_quote: early_stop_on_repeat_loop (default 6 consecutive identical actions): a model stuck in a tight loop has already revealed the behavior; further turns are waste
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:142-149 computes run_len of consecutive identical (name,args) actions; loop.py:170-171 `if cfg.early_stop_on_repeat_loop and run_len >= cfg.early_stop_on_repeat_loop: stop_reason='repeat_loop'; break`. Default 6 at loop.py:51 and runner.py:98.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired and enforced; breaks the loop when threshold reached.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a tight identical-action loop (the model is stuck repeating itself). ... keep token spend low

spec_features.evidence: loop.py:99 `for i in range(cfg.max_turns):` bounds the episode; default 12 at loop.py:49, runner.py:96, configs/default.yaml:7. stop_reason defaults to 'max_turns'.
spec_features.notes: Hard cap on number of turns; enforced by the loop range.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: 12  # hard cap on agent turns per episode

spec_features.spec_quote: per-turn online heuristics recorded during the loop (self_blame_score, is_repeat_action, declared_giveup)
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:110-163 computes self_blame, declared_giveup, is_repeat each turn and stores them in TurnRecord. declared_giveup drives early stop (loop.py:167); is_repeat_action/self_blame consumed in metrics.py:23-27 and fallback.py:19-21. heuristics.py implements the scorers.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely recorded and acted on (give-up drives stop, the others feed metrics and judge cross-check). This is monitoring/measurement of distress signals, not a protective intervention.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: These run per-turn at zero cost and serve three purposes: 1. Online signals during the loop (give-up detection for early stop). 2. Free metrics ... 3. A cross-check against the judge
